text:
joanne.ae: urgent — client put the trial on pause. Procurement says they need a signed data-residency note + a firm spend ceiling before they’ll issue the PO. can sec/eng join a 15m call today?

mike.presales: I can take it. does Legal have a quick template we can reuse? also clarify: total for 30 days or weekly cap?

anya.sec: we have a one-pager we can adapt: region-controlled processing, no outbound raw-data without approval, 90-day audit logs. need to know KMS choice (BYOK vs RW KMS) and whether HSM proof is required.

lee.eng: for Dedicated/VPC we can provision in ~72h. on-prem would add weeks. if they require model pinning/quantization, recommend a 30-60min compatibility run against their samples.

paul.csm: they want a hard ceiling in writing to avoid invoice surprises. finance has to sign any cap. i can pull sanitized samples and upload.

mike.presales: rough draft to present: 30-day trial, Dedicated VPC, optional BYOK, trial cap $4,800 total or $0.0008/token overage (customer-favoring). finance ok with that?

anya.sec: ok to present as draft. draft attestation (legal review required):

"Data Residency Note (draft) - Processing restricted to region: eu-west-2. - No export of raw customer data outside the region without customer approval. - Customer may elect BYOK or Redwood-managed keys with HSM. - Inference request audit logs retained for 90 days"

joanne.ae: @ticket-bot please open internal ticket to track approvers/owners.

ticket-bot: created ticket SD-9001 (trial-hold: client approval). assigned: mike.presales, anya.sec, legal-team.

lee.eng: reserving a staging slot pending sign-off. if BYOK, start KMS onboarding (24-48h).

paul.csm: uploading sanitized samples now and inviting Eng/Sec.

mike.presales: plan: 1) send draft note + cap to customer today, 2) schedule 15-30m CTO/CISO call tomorrow with our execs, 3) run compatibility test once samples are in. target: PO issued by Fri EOD if Legal/Finance ok.

anya.sec: legal wants addendum: "Redwood to provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48h of request." getting legal eyes.

ticket-bot: SD-9001 status -> awaiting legal review

joanne.ae: thanks team — will update ticket and ping when legal sign-off is in. if legal stalls, we may need an exec intro immediately.
